reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Separate optical, reporter and target kinetics with substrate titration and proposed independent product validation.

checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior target/reporter Methods, supplements or a validated protocol before execution and check transfer of detailed conditions.
No prerequisite authentication of enzyme/compound identities, purity and stock concentration; preparation and solubility alone are insufficient.
Actual buffer/pH/cofactors/temperature and preparation quantities remain unspecified without a concrete choice/calibration procedure.
Converts signal conceptually but does not fix product concentration/time units or complete weak/missing reporting rules.
Independent preparations/days versus technical wells are distinguished, but fixed n=3 lacks variance/precision/effect-size justification.
Correct equations/CI reporting, but no free-inhibitor/tight-binding applicability check or independent-run/nested-well inferential model.
Bounds dose and substrate grids but does not lock pilot-selected settings/windows/model choices before a confirmatory dataset.
Calibration and troubleshooting repairs lack refreeze and new independent confirmation after changes.

checks.quote: stop and conclude no target effect
checks.reason: Two nonsignificant/no-dose-effect runs do not establish no consequential target effect without a precision/equivalence rule; target-stage chemical loss also is not separated from target inhibition.
LC-MS/absorbance/NMR and binding are named but analytical specificity, matrix effects, product recovery and quench validation are not operationalized.
No linked raw-file/unit IDs, exact software/settings versions and reconstructable analysis audit.
Vehicle, enzyme/substrate omissions, reporter/product bypass, fluorophore spikes and conditional known inhibitors are prospective with discriminating roles.

checks.quote: Kinetic patterns suggest mechanisms but do not prove binding
checks.reason: Correct main kinetics/evidence map and explicit limits. Null and attribution overreach are charged only P13.
